heldout_preregistration.history: Reconstructed initial position from the inspected diagram; no invented prehistory. Black kingside castling right is supported by the book continuation 22...O-O.
heldout_preregistration.expectation: h3 supplies g4 support for the e2 bishop and prepares exchanging the e6 defender. The actual engine roots and replies remain authoritative; their purposes, different realizations/remaining pawn or square costs must be explained if supported.

first_live_results.finding: Actual g4/e5 comparison shows the knight beneficiary and actual Nxe5/dxe5 choice with Rxd6 recovery versus a retained pawn deficit. The fresh line uses a rook, not the previous stored Nxd6. Repetition and incidental conditions remain.

g4 support and the e2 bishop use are discovered without case-specific tuning. The alternate h4 purpose is unknown; reply inquiry still chooses a speculative g-pawn advance and calls hxg4 the purpose. Post-exchange structural costs are listed but not connected to the original bishop idea.

continued_common_diagnosis: MovePurpose.discover admits supported pawns but excludes supported bishops/other pieces. Its unseen g2-g4 question therefore survives even when the shared beneficiary reader has an actual Bg4 witness. The scheduler and explanation disagree on the task identity.

additional_live_failure.diagnosis: Supported beneficiary discovery read only the root PV, while redeployment discovery also used the independent reply survey. This lost the same idea when the engine returned a different short root PV.

implementation: Root-created vacancy, cleared route and newly supported entry share physical beneficiary activity, actual retreat/recovery and bounded exchange costs.
Strong returned replies can be compared through the same beneficiary task and different costs, even when both capture.
Question selection and explanation share supported-entry tracking for every piece, preserving the source path and continuous provider.
A local exchange can pass a removed controller's function to the next allied user, with actual contacts and remaining enemy control. An intervening own plan breaks this connection.
Full reply surveys can supply a witnessed supported beneficiary absent from the short root PV; forced subsets cannot discover their own task.
Independent client checks preserve the same actual survey owner, purpose question, physical provider and complete prices.

final_live_result.visible_result: English support-fact fallback, with neither root purpose explained. No further retries were made to obtain a favorable PV.
